a: Temperature rescales the whole distribution; top_p truncates to the probability nucleus. Tune one, not both.
Dense embeddings shred exact identifiers into sub-tokens; BM25 catches them. Fuse with RRF, then rerank.

q: What makes something an agent, and its safety rails?
a: A model in a loop with tools (reason->act->observe). Rails: step cap + timeout in code, sandboxing, least privilege, HITL, graceful degradation.
MCP adds runtime discovery, standard transports, and sessions on top of tool calling. Write the server once, any client uses it.

q: Direct vs indirect injection; why unsolved?
a: Direct: user types it. Indirect: hidden in data the agent reads (the 2026 nightmare). Structural (instructions+data share one channel), so contain, don't filter.
